proved_statements: For k>=3, B_k is connected simple cubic of order 28k-26 and c_ind(B_k)=14k-13.
M_k is an odd spanning pseudoforest with j(M_k)=1.
Every repair through odd pseudoforests passes through j>=k; the exact excess barrier is k-1.
The shortest repair has k exchanges, attained with j-values 1,2,...,k,0.

independent_checks.double_cover_repairs: All have verified two-cycle repairs with j=2,1,0 and good sets of order n/2+4.

exploratory_solver_scope: A one-cycle CP-SAT model confirmed no immediate repair at order 58. It found one-step repairs for double covers at 116,172,228; order 284 timed out UNKNOWN. Subsequent explicit two-cycle certificates verify repair for all ten tested covers, including order 284.
limitations: No proof or counterexample for the original induced cycles conjecture.
Existence of an isolated-edge-free odd spanning pseudoforest in every cubic graph remains unproved.
The barrier family has bridges. The tested bridgeless double covers do not inherit its obstruction.
Finite checks verify stated examples; the unbounded claim follows from the written proof.
